summary: Highlander Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K (Business Acquisition Report) disclosing its completed acquisition of Bear Creek Mining Corporation via a plan of arrangement on February 26, 2026. Highlander acquired all Bear Creek common shares not already owned in exchange for 0.1175 Highlander shares per Bear Creek share, issuing ~36.2 million shares. Concurrently, Highlander paid US$6.2 million and US$1.6 million in cash to Royal Gold and Equinox, respectively, as part of debt settlements, and granted net smelter return royalties on Bear Creek's Corani Project and Mercedes mine. Bear Creek became a wholly-owned subsidiary. No termination fee or premium is stated. Watch for integration execution and post-merger production guidance.
